summary: Learn foundational cloud risk, access and configuration reviews through practical scenarios. Explore the course outline and plan your training.
lede: Cloud computing cybersecurity fundamentals help IT and security professionals review cloud services, identify risks and document controls. The course develops skills in mapping shared responsibility, reviewing cloud access and configuration, and assessing data-protection choices. Learners also practise prioritizing gaps with NIST CSF 2.0 and recording incident-readiness and remediation actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support, configure, review or oversee cloud services and need a practical foundation in security responsibilities, access controls and configuration risks.
modules: Cloud Service Models and Shared Responsibility
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace IT and cloud services is helpful. No prior cloud-security experience or programming is required.
